name: list_orders
description: List a customer's orders, newest first, as summaries. Results are paginated at 20 per page: total_matches reports how many orders matched in full, and next_cursor is non-null whenever more pages remain. Pass next_cursor back as cursor to continue. Do not conclude an order is absent from a single page; check total_matches.

status.description: Return only orders in this state.

since.description: Return only orders placed at or after this moment. ISO-8601 instant with a UTC offset, e.g. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. A bare date without a time and offset is rejected.

limit.description: Orders per page. Values above 20 are capped at 20.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous call's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

error_returns.when: No account exists with the given customer_id.
since is not an ISO-8601 instant, or is missing a UTC offset.
